title: Stained Glass Dreamscape
description: A vibrant stained glass style scene depicts a woman in a flowing blue floral robe standing on a colorful cobblestone Parisian street. She reaches toward a radiant sun while a river with koi fish flows from the roots of a large tree on the right, blending into a surreal landscape with the Sacré-Cœur Basilica, floating buildings, and cherry blossoms.
prompt: A highly detailed stained glass artwork showing a mystical woman in a long blue robe with orange flowers standing on a colorful Parisian street with shops and umbrellas. She reaches upward toward a glowing sun. To the right, a large tree with roots forming a flowing river filled with koi fish and stars. In the background, the Sacré-Cœur Basilica rises above the city under a sunset sky with floating classical buildings and cherry blossoms.
